column1: # Pinned dev toolchain, read by scripts/tools.sh (make tools).
# Columns (tab-separated): name  version  platform  url  sha256
# Rule: a pin is the newest stable release published at least 7 days before it was pinned.
# Pinned on 2026-11-20. The sha256 comes from the vendor's checksum file: tofu (tofu_<v>_SHA256SUMS),
# tflint and tflint-ruleset-google (checksums.txt), gitleaks (gitleaks_<v>_checksums.txt). shellcheck
# publishes no checksum file: its sha256 is the GitHub release-asset digest, confirmed against the
# downloaded bytes. bats is the GitHub tag archive (no vendor checksum exists), hashed on download
# (trust on first use of the tag archive, not vendor-attested).
# tflint-ruleset-google is unpacked under .tools/opt and linked into .tools/tflint-plugins (the
# Makefile sets TFLINT_PLUGIN_DIR), so `tflint --init` never downloads anything.
# Rows with url uv:<pkg> are Python tools, each in its own venv .tools/uv-tools/<name>, installed with
# `uv pip install --require-hashes -r tools/requirements/<name>.txt`. Regenerate the requirements with
# `echo <pkg>==<ver> | uv pip compile - --generate-hashes --python-version 3.13
# --python-platform x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu`. Their sha256 column is `-` (hashes are in the file).
# `uv:python` runs `uv python install <version>`; uv verifies that download itself.
# Adding darwin-arm64: copy each linux-amd64 row, set the platform, point the url at the vendor's
# darwin/arm64 asset, take its sha256 from the same checksum file, and fix scripts/tools.sh if the
# asset layout differs.
tofu
tflint
tflint-ruleset-google
gitleaks
shellcheck
bats
python
checkov
